verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official CLI for building, testing, and managing a Stripe integration from the command line, including creating a sandbox, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. The evidence covers the CLI only at the platform level, not specifically for invoicing. Missing for 10: evidence of invoice-specific CLI commands (create/finalize/send invoices), documentation of AI/agent-oriented CLI workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
